Scenario redesign side plates (1024×512, nose right, transparent) for all 20 player hulls.

Locked into flight and hangar:

- Batch 1: `wren.png` (starter courier, 1 engine), `sparrow.png` (light scout, 1 engine), `kestrel.png` (light fighter, 2 engines, teal accents).
- Batch 2: `mule.png` (hauler, 2 engines), `rook.png` (patrol + dish, 2 engines), `tern.png` (scout, 1 engine), `jackal.png` (light fighter, 2 engines, teal hardpoints, no lettering).
- Batch 3: `magpie.png`, `mole.png`, `osprey.png`, `falcon.png`, `albatross.png`, `ox.png`, `vulture.png`, `heron.png`, `badger.png`, `raptor.png`, `condor.png`, `goliath.png`, `eagle.png`.

Alternate renders stay out of `dist/`. If a PNG is missing, hull paint falls back to the procedural silhouette. All 20 hulls have thruster, flyby, and land MP3s under `dist/assets/audio/ships/`.
